title: Ledger
description: A royalty statement you edit in place — Tab and the arrow keys walk the grid, every cell saves itself behind a sweeping hairline, and the payout and the grand total roll digit by digit when it lands. One save fails on purpose, one row is already paid and locked, and a countdown ring gives you six seconds to take any of it back.
intent: A dense, tabular-numeral data surface on the light ground with one mechanic finished to the edge — real content, full keyboard control, and numbers that roll rather than jump, which is the interface work Herb asked for over abstract demos.
